purpose: Tree-structure-level export for a Rust port. For a feature vector x ordered per `features`: walk each tree from node 0, comparing x[feature[node]] <= threshold[node] to choose children_left/children_right, until a node with children_left[node] == -1 (a leaf); that leaf's depth (edges from the root) plus its `leaf_correction` is the tree's path length. Average the path length over all trees, then: raw_score = 2 ** (-mean_path_length / global_path_length_correction). This equals `-model.score_samples(x)` (sklearn's own sign convention is reversed: lower score_samples = more anomalous, so this codebase negates it throughout, see IsolationForestLayer.raw_score).
